title: Swipe Card Layout Fix
changes: Fixed the Journey / Japan Ready carousel so the active card is fully readable while only a controlled sliver of the neighbouring card is visible.
Centered mobile scroll-snap points and added balanced left/right carousel padding to prevent card headings and content being clipped.
Fixed the Keep Learning carousel so Review/Practice cards no longer get cut off or overflow their card boundaries.
Changed mobile Keep Learning cards to a consistent viewport-relative width with centered snapping and proper edge padding.
Kept desktop layouts side by side and removed mobile width constraints from desktop cards.
Retains all v11.7.2 headings, touch/mouse/keyboard behavior, performance fixes and learning-summary features.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.7.3.
